# Module map

<!-- Generated by scripts/build-modules-map.js from the code and the folder purposes written in it. Do not edit by hand: run `npm run docs:modules` (scripts/test-modules-map.js fails when this file is stale). -->

Where the code is and what each part may touch. The folders of `migration/src/lib` are the modules; each file in them starts with a header that
says what it owns, what it reads and writes, and what it must not do (`scripts/test-module-headers.js` holds that). The data flow is
[DATA-FLOW.md](DATA-FLOW.md), the rules of each part [RULES.md](RULES.md).

## How the lib folders depend on each other

An arrow means "imports from", read from the code. What each built page really carries is what `npm run analyze:bundle` lists, by folder; `npm run test:bundle`
holds what the participant page must not carry (the libraries of the admin page, the Results charts, the exports, the modules of Setup).

```mermaid

  access --> schema
  admin --> access
  admin --> brand
  admin --> common
  admin --> data
  admin --> exports
  admin --> participant
  admin --> results
  admin --> schema
  brand --> common
  brand --> data
  brand --> participant
  common --> data

  data --> brand

  effects --> motion
  exports --> admin
  exports --> brand
  exports --> data
  exports --> participant
  exports --> results
  participant --> brand
  participant --> common
  participant --> data
  participant --> motion
  results --> admin
  results --> data
  results --> exports
  results --> participant

  settings --> common
  settings --> data

  setup --> brand
  setup --> data
  setup --> participant
  setup --> schema
  setup --> settings
```

## The folders

| Folder | What it is for | Files |
|---|---|---:|
| `migration/src/` | The three entries (`main.ts`, `admin-main.ts`, `setup-main.ts`), the three apps (`App.svelte`, `AdminApp.svelte`, `SetupApp.svelte`) and their page-wide CSS. The HTML shells are `migration/index.html`, `admin.html` and `setup.html`. | 8 |
| `migration/src/admin/` | The admin page's screens (Svelte): the five tabs, Brand Studio, dialogs, the Live display, the print sheet, the report buttons. | 59 |
| `migration/src/admin/charts/` | The Results charts, drawn by hand in HTML and SVG (no chart library): the card, bars, the scale, the split bar, words, names, the table view, the tooltip. | 10 |
| `migration/src/assets/report-fonts/` | The Open Sans subset of the leader report (generated by `npm run build:report-fonts`, with its licence). | 1 |
| `migration/src/components/` | The participant page's building blocks (Svelte): the shell, pills, buttons, the hero plate, tiles, the progress bar, the sound switch. | 17 |
| `migration/src/dev/` | The styleguide, `#/styleguide` on the dev server only (absent from builds). | 1 |
| `migration/src/lib/access/` | Roles and access (Prompt 21): the role matrix (board 10), the one check can(), AccessDenied, the data layer's write guard, who is signed in, grants and their guards, the audit writer, the copy of the old admins list. | 17 |
| `migration/src/lib/admin/` | The admin page's rules and data: Today, Clients, Content, Guests and QR, Results, the Live display's session, the PIN check. | 26 |
| `migration/src/lib/brand/` | A client's look: deriving a readable theme from a colour, the stored theme, Brand Studio's rules, picture slots, cropping, compressing and naming. | 18 |
| `migration/src/lib/common/` | Shared by the pages: the product name, the heading focus rule, kiosk lock-down, the polling schedule and its one timer, the admin page's address. | 8 |
| `migration/src/lib/data/` | The data layer: dataService.js, the door every page imports, over its parts (core.js holds the state and alone talks to SharePoint REST or, on the local server, its JSON API), and grouping of long id lists into short reads. Every page carries it. | 25 |
| `migration/src/lib/effects/` | Sounds and confetti, behind one door (`effects.ts`): which moment makes which effect, the cues as data, Web Audio, canvas-confetti. | 6 |
| `migration/src/lib/exports/` | The files a leader gets: the leader report (data, counting, layout, PDF writer, fonts) and the Live display's summary pack (PDF, PowerPoint) and summary CSV. | 7 |
| `migration/src/lib/motion/` | The participant screens' motion, behind one door (`motion.ts`): the plan by kind of question and part of a screen, the tokens and shapes (CSS), the level and the governor. | 2 |
| `migration/src/lib/participant/` | The participant page: the boot sequence, the visit, the activities held for the page's life, the pager's rules, saving answers, screen moves. | 16 |
| `migration/src/lib/results/` | Results counted and shown: the tally, the chart model (every number a chart shows), the palette, the figure on paper, names, the takeaways, where a tooltip goes. | 17 |
| `migration/src/lib/schema/` | The lists and columns: `pms-schema.js`, the names every page carries, and `pms-schema-meta.js`, everything else about them (Setup, the tests and the generators only). | 3 |
| `migration/src/lib/settings/` | How a page starts: the browser check, where its settings come from (`pms-config.txt`, the build, its address), which site and lists are its own, and the stop screen. | 8 |
| `migration/src/lib/setup/` | The Setup page's own modules: the plan and Create, Mark the site as ready, the admins, the seed-file import, the sample clients and their pictures, the self-test's probes. | 11 |
| `migration/src/pager/` | The pager: one question per screen, its answers, and an activity's completion screen. | 4 |
| `migration/src/routes/` | The participant page's screens: Welcome, the Activities hub, the quiz route, the finale, "not live", the preview, and the old addresses that redirect. | 10 |
| `migration/src/setup/` | Setup's pieces (Svelte): the copy panel, where the lists are, the plan view, and the sample pictures as data. | 5 |
| `migration/src/unsupported/` | The "needs a recent browser" notice: a page and an ES5 check, put into each HTML shell at build time. | 1 |
| `scripts/` | Node tests (`test-*.js`, run by `npm test` and the `test:*` scripts), the mocked SharePoint (`sharepoint-fake.js`), the oracle, the bundle and request baselines, the generators and the release packager. | 152 |
| `scripts/local-site/` | The local PCOE stand-in (`npm run local:site`), its scenarios and VJR's dummy dataset, the screenshot harness and the measurements. | 11 |
| `scripts/migration-tests/` | The Playwright specs of `npm run test:migration`, and their harnesses (`admin-local.ts`, `polling-support.ts`, `fixtures.ts`). | 81 |
| `scripts/rehearsal-tests/` | The rehearsal of RUNBOOK.md on the mock with a package's own pages (`npm run test:rehearsal`). | 1 |
| `scripts/schema-baseline/` | The schema as it was before Phase 10c-2b, and the scripts that translated the request baselines (each baseline names the one that touched it). | 11 |
| `scripts/styleguide-tests/` | The styleguide's audit (`npm run test:styleguide`). | 1 |
| `server/` | The local stand-in for SharePoint: an Express API over JSON files (`server/data/`, committed seed data), with ETag concurrency and picture uploads. Development and tests only. | 3 |

## `lib/access/`

Roles and access (Prompt 21): the role matrix (board 10), the one check can(), AccessDenied, the data layer's write guard, who is signed in, grants and their guards, the audit writer, the copy of the old admins list.

- **Imports from:** `lib/schema`
- **Imported by:** `lib/admin`, `src`, `src/admin`, `src/setup`
- **Node suites that import it:** `test-access-recheck.js`, `test-access.js`, `test-aop-editor.js`, `test-hardening.js`, `test-leader-dashboard.js`, `test-reporting-settings.js`, `test-scope.js`, `test-sessions-plan.js`, `test-users.js`

| Module | What it is (its header) | Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `access-denied.js` | The one typed error of access (Prompt 21, Phase 1): what the data layer's write guard and the grant rules throw when the role matrix does not allow what was asked. | `AccessDenied`, `isAccessDenied` |
| `access-matrix.js` | The role matrix (Prompt 21, Phase 1): which role may do what, and how a role's place applies. | `ROLES`, `ROLE_SCOPES`, `ACTIONS`, `MATRIX`, `EXTRAS`, `LEGACY_ADMIN`, `LEGACY_ACTIONS`, `LIST_WRITES`, `FIELD_WRITES`, `matrixRows` |
| `access-words.js` | What the admin page says about access (Prompt 21, Phase 1): the No access screen (board 2) and the site owner's banner (board 10's edge states). | `OWNER_BANNER`, `noAccessWords`, `myDetails` |
| `audit-review.js` | The audit review (Prompt 21, Phase 7): a Super admin's read-only look at every line of PMSAuditLog (decision J), newest first, in words, filtered by what was done, by a person (who did it or to whom) and by days, 50 lines to a page. | `AUDIT_PAGE`, `AUDIT_FILTERS`, `auditView` |
| `audit.js` | The audit writer (Prompt 21, Phase 1, decision J): one line in PMSAuditLog for every grant, removal, added person, disable and copy of the old admins list, and (Prompt 22) every change of the reporting settings and of a client's Industry or Region, and (Prompt 23) a guest's picture added or removed (the guest's id, never the picture). | `AUDIT_DETAIL_MAX`, `AUDIT_ACTIONS`, `writeAudit` |
| `can.js` | The one check of access (Prompt 21, Phase 1): can(access, action, target) reads the role matrix (access-matrix.js) and the person's assignment rows, with ValidUntil honoured at the moment of the call. | `extrasOf`, `userKeyOf`, `legacyAccess`, `grantsOf`, `allowsIn`, `can`, `canView` |
| `field-values.js` | The values the guarded columns may hold (Prompt 22): the fiscal-year start month (1 to 12), the minimum sample (a whole number, 1 or more) and a client's Industry and Region (plain text, at most 60 characters), each also empty. | `TAG_MAX`, `fieldProblem`, `invalidValue` |
| `grants.js` | Giving and removing roles (Prompt 21, Phase 1): an assignment's id, who may give or remove which role (a Super admin gives Super admin, Admin and Leadership for all clients in a period; an Admin gives a client's or a session's team roles), the guards (never the last Super admin, never your own roles), and the Super admins now. grantRole() writes the row and its audit line; a grant given twice is "already granted" (the unique AppId: | `placeOf`, `assignmentId`, `grantProblem`, `grantRole`, `revokeProblem`, `superAdmins`, `disableProblem` |
| `guard.js` | The data layer's write guard (Prompt 21, Phase 1): what lib/data/core.js asks before every write it sends, once a page has installed one (dataService.setAccessGuard). | `changeOf`, `writeGuard` |
| `migrate-admins.js` | The switch-over (Prompt 21, Phase 1): | `MIGRATED_ROLES`, `makeMeSuperAdmin`, `migrateAdmins` |
| `owners.js` | Who owns what (Prompt 21, Phase 4): the write guard cannot tell from a write alone which client an item belongs to (a question names its activity, an option its question, a session's start names only the session), so the page remembers the owners of what it reads and writes: a session's client and date, an activity's client, a question's activity. | `UNKNOWN_OWNER`, `newOwners`, `mayRead` |
| `people-ops.js` | What the Users screens do to people and their access (Prompt 21, Phase 2; boards 3 and 4): add a person (and give them no access), turn one off or on, remove a role, switch an extra, read a person's history. | `emailProblem`, `addPerson`, `setStatus`, `removeRole`, `setExtras`, `loseWords`, `auditWords`, `historyOf` |
| `people.js` | The Users list's rules (Prompt 21, Phase 2; board 3): each person's roles and reach from their assignment rows, the role chips, the filters (search, client, session, status), the sessions of a client by date, time and title, and the pages of fifty. | `PAGE_SIZE`, `ROLE_CHIPS`, `dayWords`, `sessionTitle`, `sessionLabel`, `sessionsOfClient`, `reachWords`, `peopleRows`, `filterPeople`, `pageOf` |
| `picker.js` | The people picker's behaviour (Prompt 21, Phase 2; board 4): search as you type for Add user. | `MIN_CHARS`, `MAX_SUGGESTIONS`, `SEARCH_DELAY_MS`, `createPicker`, `pickerWords` |
| `resolve.js` | Who is signed in, and what that lets them do (Prompt 21, Phase 1). resolveAccess() asks the data layer who the account is and whether it owns the site (one request), then reads their PMSUsers row and PMSRoleAssignments rows (two indexed reads, sent together): the cost stays the same whatever the number of people. | `forgetAccess`, `resolveAccess`, `signInStep`, `RECHECK_AFTER_MS`, `recheckDue`, `lostAccess`, `withoutGrants` |
| `scope.js` | Scoping by role (Prompt 21, Phase 4; wireframe boards 7, 8 and 10): what the admin page shows a person, and what it may ask the lists for. | 15 exports |
| `team.js` | A client's team (Prompt 21, Phase 3; wireframe board 6): who has a Producer's, a Designer's or Leadership's role on the client or on its sessions, the people the panel offers (registered and active in PMSUsers only), the Add form's rules (a person, a role, the whole client or selected sessions, a Designer's "may also edit activities"), and adding (grants.js grantRole: one row for the whole client, or one for each selected session, each with its audit line). | `TEAM_ROLES`, `teamRows`, `teamCandidates`, `teamProblems`, `addToTeam`, `sessionTeamWords` |

## `lib/common/`

- **Node suites that import it:** `test-access.js`, `test-aop-editor.js`, `test-bundle-budget.js`, `test-column-names.js`, `test-confidence-check.js`, `test-fake-site.js`, `test-guest-group.js`, `test-guest-picture.js`, `test-lists-reference.js`, `test-motion-plan.js`, `test-named-reads.js`, `test-provision-prefix.js`, `test-provision.js`, `test-release-docs.js`, `test-request-baseline.js`, `test-schema-upgrade.js`, `test-schema-version.js`, `test-schema.js`, `test-session-delete.js`, `test-sessions-plan.js`, `test-setup-admins.js`, `test-sharepoint.js`, `test-shown-names.js`, `test-site-ready.js`, `test-text-limits.js`

| Module | What it is (its header) | Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `aop-rules.js` | What an Art of the Possible question and a guest's picture may be (Prompt 23): one set of limits and words, which the data layer asks before it writes (lib/data/records.js) and the screens ask before they save (admin/QuestionEditor.svelte, admin/GuestPicture.svelte). | `AOP_LIMITS`, `DIRECTIONS`, `COPIED_FROM`, `GUEST_PICTURE_NAME`, `criteriaProblem`, `fteProblem`, `rowsProblem`, `guestPictureProblem` |
| `pms-schema-meta.js` | Everything about the app's SharePoint lists that the pages themselves do not need: for each list what it is for, who uses it and how fast it grows, and for each column its SharePoint type, whether it must exist, whether it is indexed and unique, the words it may hold, its longest value, its default, what it is for, who reads and writes it, and whether it holds personal data (Phase 10c-2b). | `META`, `RETIRED`, `retiredColumn`, `columnNamesAt`, `LIBRARY_META`, `columnsOf`, `LOCAL_FILE` |
| `pms-schema.js` | The app's SharePoint lists and their columns, as the data layer reads and writes them: | `ID`, `VERSION`, `LIBRARY`, `LISTS`, `selectOf`, `versionSelect` |

## `lib/settings/`

How a page starts: the browser check, where its settings come from (`pms-config.txt`, the build, its address), which site and lists are its own, and the stop screen.

- **Imports from:** `lib/common`, `lib/data`
- **Imported by:** `lib/common`, `lib/setup`, `src`, `src/dev`, `src/setup`
- **Node suites that import it:** `test-deploy-settings.js`, `test-release-docs.js`, `test-review-9a.js`, `test-schema-upgrade.js`, `test-schema-version.js`, `test-settings-file.js`, `test-setup-deployment.js`, `test-site-override.js`

| Module | What it is (its header) | Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `address-check.js` | Is this page on the developer's local server, or on a SharePoint site? Plain JS with JSDoc and no DOM, so `node --test` imports it. | `isLocalAddress` |
| `built-settings.ts` | The settings the build put into this page (Phase 10b): the PMS_ environment variables of scripts/site-override.js, in the shape of pms-config.txt, and `{}` for a build that was given none. | `BUILT`, `BUILD` |
| `deploy-problems.js` | What a page says when it cannot tell which site and lists are its own (Phase 10b). | `PUBLISHER`, `PROBLEM_IDS`, `LISTS_PROBLEM_IDS`, `problem` |
| `deploy-rules.js` | The rules of the settings, in words (Phase 10b). | `siteUrlProblem`, `settingsProblem`, `spelledOut` |
| `deploy-settings.js` | Which SharePoint site and which lists this copy of the app uses (Phase 10b). | `SETTINGS_FILE`, `wrongSetting`, `siteOf`, `listTitles`, `resolveSettings` |
| `settings-file.js` | Reads pms-config.txt, the settings file beside the page (Phase 10b; named .txt since Phase 10g: the first real site would not hand out a .json file from a document library, and did serve a .txt, so the file's name is .txt and its content is still JSON). | `readSettingsFile` |
| `start.ts` | How each of the three pages starts (Phase 10b): find out which site and lists are this copy's, tell the data layer, then mount. | `deployment`, `settingsRead`, `findSettings`, `startPage` |
| `support.ts` | The first import of every entry (main.ts, admin-main.ts, setup-main.ts). | `mounted` |

## `lib/setup/`

The Setup page's own modules: the plan and Create, Mark the site as ready, the admins, the seed-file import, the sample clients and their pictures, the self-test's probes.

- **Imports from:** `lib/admin`, `lib/brand`, `lib/data`, `lib/participant`, `lib/schema`, `lib/settings`, `src/setup`
- **Imported by:** `src`, `src/dev`
- **Node suites that import it:** `test-admin-content.js`, `test-admin-today.js`, `test-brand-storage.js`, `test-brand.js`, `test-bundle-budget.js`, `test-column-names.js`, `test-confidence-check.js`, `test-duplicates.js`, `test-hardening.js`, `test-list-namespace.js`, `test-live-display.js`, `test-named-reads.js`, `test-participant-storage.js`, `test-participant-waits.js`, `test-provision-prefix.js`, `test-provision.js`, `test-review-9b.js`, `test-sample-pictures.js`, `test-schema-upgrade.js`, `test-schema.js`, `test-seeds.js`, `test-session-delete.js`, `test-sessions-plan.js`, `test-setup-admins.js`, `test-setup-deployment.js`, `test-sharepoint.js`, `test-site-ready.js`, `test-text-limits.js`

| Module | What it is (its header) | Exports |
|---|---|---|
| `list-permissions.js` | The access lists' own permissions (Prompt 21, Phase 7): what moves the access check from a guardrail in the page towards a boundary on the site. | `PERMISSION_LISTS`, `ACCESS_GROUP`, `ADD_ONLY_LEVEL`, `PROBE_PERMISSIONS`, `permissionSteps`, `permissionFindings`, `permissionProbe` |
| `provision.js` | Preparing a site for the app (Phase 10c-3): the plan of what is missing, worked out from the site as it is. | 17 exports |
| `sample-clients.js` | The two sample clients: | `checkContent`, `samplePack`, `CHECK_LABELS`, `CHECK_PROMPT` |
| `sample-pictures.js` | GENERATED by scripts/build-sample-pictures.js (npm run build:sample-pictures): do not edit by hand. | `SAMPLE_PICTURES`, `SAMPLE_PICTURE_NAMES` |
| `sample-seed.js` | "Seed sample clients", with the clients' pictures (Phase 10f). | `LOCAL_PICTURES`, `UPLOADED`, `ALREADY_THERE`, `pictureAddresses`, `localSamplePack`, `seedSampleClients` |
| `seed.js` | Seeding: puts a pack of clients and their activities into the backend through the data service, so the same code seeds the local server and SharePoint. | `FILLABLE`, `seedPack` |
| `setup-admins.js` | Setup's "Add an admin" (Phase 10c-3): the first facilitator of a new site, and any after. | `ADMIN_PIN`, `newAdminProblem`, `adminNames`, `addAdmin` |
| `setup-checks.js` | What the Setup page adds to its list check and its self-test: what it expects of every column, in full (Phase 10c-2b), two read-only probes of the tenant (Phase 9b, G), a third (Phase 10h: which columns it leaves out of a read that names none) and a fourth (Phase 10i: which columns it will not return by name). | `typeLabel`, `schemaSpecs`, `PROBE_YESNO`, `PROBE_LENGTH`, `PROBE_LENGTHS`, `PROBE_LEFT_OUT`, `PROBE_REFUSED`, `selfTestProbes` |
| `setup-deployment.js` | What Setup says about this copy of the app (Phase 10b). | `folderOf`, `copyRows`, `waysToFix`, `listRows`, `readListAddresses`, `sameListByAddress` |
| `setup-import.js` | Setup's import of a seed file (`npm run export:sharepoint`): content made on another copy of the app, put on this site where it is missing. | `adminsInSeed`, `importSeed` |
| `setupData.ts` | The Setup page's door to the data layer and to the Setup-only modules (the plan and Create, Mark the site as ready, the admins, the seed-file import, the sample clients and the self-test). | 16 exports |

## Pages and their entries

| Page | HTML shell | Entry | App | Vite config |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Participant (`index.html`) | `migration/index.html` | `migration/src/main.ts` | `migration/src/App.svelte` | `migration/vite.config.ts` |
| Admin (`admin.html`) | `migration/admin.html` | `migration/src/admin-main.ts` | `migration/src/AdminApp.svelte` | `migration/vite.admin.config.ts` |
| Setup (`setup.html`) | `migration/setup.html` | `migration/src/setup-main.ts` | `migration/src/SetupApp.svelte` | `migration/vite.setup.config.ts` |

`npm run build:svelte:release` (`scripts/build-svelte-release.js`) builds the three into one file each with `vite-plugin-singlefile`.
